title: How to Verify Probabilistic Consistency of Predictive Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.11181v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When a probabilistic predictor answers many conditional-probability queries, are its answers self-consistent, and can this be verified in polynomial time? This problem is of interest for AI safety, where safety is derived from honesty about probabilistic predictions of unwanted outcomes potentially caused by an AI action. We construct an interactive PCP as follows. Let a predictive model be specified by a probability circuit P and a circuit Q which outputs confidence in predictions. Together, P and Q implicitly specify exponentially many probabilistic claims. We show a protocol in which a polynomial-time verifier can verify the approximate consistency of (P,Q). The verifier is given the pair of circuits (P,Q), which it evaluates at only a few points; alongside them it is given a proof oracle, an encoding of a witnessing probability distribution allegedly consistent with the predictions of (P,Q), which it reads at a few location

translated_title: 如何验证预测模型的概率一致性
translated_abstract: 当一个概率预测器回答大量条件概率查询时，它的答案是否自洽？能否在多项式时间内验证这一点？这个问题对于AI安全具有重要意义，因为其安全性源自对AI行为可能引发的不良后果进行概率预测时的诚实性。我们构建了一个交互式PCP（概率可检验证明）协议。设预测模型由概率电路P和一个输出预测置信度的电路Q指定。P和Q共同隐式地指定了指数级多的概率断言。我们提出了一个协议，使多项式时间的验证者能够验证(P,Q)的近似一致性。验证者获得电路对(P,Q)，只在少数几个点上对它们进行求值；同时它还获得一个证明预言机——这是据称与(P,Q)的预测相一致的一个见证概率分布的编码——验证者只读取其中的少数位置。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种交互式PCP协议，使多项式时间的验证者能够通过少量查询验证由概率电路和置信度电路所指定的预测模型的概率自洽性，从而为AI安全中的可验证诚实预测提供了保障。
en_tdlr: The paper constructs an interactive PCP protocol enabling a polynomial-time verifier to check the approximate probabilistic self-consistency of predictive models specified by probability and confidence circuits through few queries, providing verifiable honest predictions for AI safety.
